verdict.rationale: SumUp's docs describe in-person card acceptance on its Solo and Go readers and via Tap to Pay, which accepts contactless payments on a compatible phone. Offline store-and-forward is also supported. However, chip (EMV) insertion is only implied by the card readers, and Apple Pay / Google Pay acceptance is never named. Missing for 10: explicit chip/EMV documentation, explicit Apple Pay and Google Pay wallet acceptance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
